title: Treasury Schedule — Size Quarters of Dividend Cushion on Class H Preferred Stock Purchases, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
Room is kept under the largest balance a member may hold for the coming reinvested dividends of a large Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding. The size quarters rest on the present shares: present shares of 500000 or more give 6 quarters; 100000 or more but below 500000 give 3 quarters; smaller holdings give none.

## Schedule

| Present shares of the holding | Size quarters |
|---|---|
| 500000 or more | 6 |
| 100000 or more but below 500000 | 3 |
| Below 100000 | None |

Present shares are the holding's purchases plus its reinvested dividends less its retirements. The size quarters are cushion quarters, added to any other cushion quarters of the holding; each cushion quarter keeps one quarter's coming reinvested dividend clear of the holding room when the member buys.

## Edges (hypothetical holdings)

| Present shares | Size quarters |
|---|---|
| 99,999.99 | None |
| 100,000.00 | 3 |
| 499,999.99 | 3 |
| 500,000.00 | 6 |
